lines.english: "The person you are calling is currently unavailable. Please leave a message after the beep."
"Are you out, Kazusa? I'm back in the country again. I was wondering if you'd like to have dinner with me…"
"I'm surprised."
"About what?"
"I thought you'd come to hate me even more."
"…I did hate you. Up until quite recently, in fact. Now's just not the time for that."
"Did something happen?"
"A lot has."
"For instance?"
"A lot, just like I said… A lot of fun and painful things have been keeping me busy lately, and left me no time to think about my only parent."
"Glad to hear it. Boy troubles?"
"…Don't try to lump me in with yourself."
"Ah, that's more like your usual self."
"Hmph."
"Like I said, I went to the school festival yesterday."
"Why…?"
"I got a call from Shibata-san. She told me that you would be performing on stage again after a long time."
"So you saw it…"
"I saw it, all right. You wearing that black miniskirt, showing off your legs…"
"…! I-I wasn't the one who decided on that outfit!"
"What's the matter? It's fine, isn't it? It's important for a musician to make sure the audience is paying attention to her, you know?"
"That's not the problem here… it was just so embarrassing…"
"It seemed like you were really enjoying yourself, though? You even played the sax and the bass for a while."
"I didn't decide that either…"
"And you were flirting with that guitarist boy…"
"I was not!"
"Really? No matter how I looked at it, you two sure looked like an item to me."
"Why are you suddenly changing the topic like that? You're my mother, aren't you?"
"It's exactly because I'm your mother that I'm doing this. I'd love to hear about your boyfriend."
"How can you say that after leaving me for three years…?"
"Well, I can't say you're making it easy for me if you bring that up."
"Besides, he already has a girlfriend. So he has nothing to do with me."
"The singer girl, right?"
"So he was stolen from you, huh?
Well, I suppose it's to be expected. She is pretty cute, after all. She was being open and direct about her affections, too."
"Bullseye? I guess relationships are pretty easy to read, huh?"
"She didn't steal him! It has nothing to do with me! They just got all intimate on their own!"
"You don't need to shout. It's something that happens quite often if you're a woman."
"I'm not like you, constantly going from man to man! Calling you a 'woman with love to spare' would be a fitting euphemism!"
"What are you saying? I've been thrown away too, you know? By your father, for example."
"Oh, you're not angry anymore?"
"I'm just speechless."
"Well, there's nothing to be done about that, is there? That guitarist boy seems to be a really good student. He's so polite when speaking to adults, too."
"…You've met him?"
"Only briefly. He was the one who led me to the gymnasium."
"I see…"
"He doesn't seem like the type to perform in a band. If I had to say, I think he's more likely to become a doctor or a lawyer in the future."
"He always gets top scores on tests, and he's a class representative, but he's also an idiot."
"Ah… that's a shame, then.
He wouldn't care for you, behaving like a delinquent just because you have a single parent, would he?"
"He… He's not the kind to discriminate against others over something like that!"
"…Really now?"
"He treats everyone equally, and is always nosy… Even if he's bluntly refused over and over, he'll still meddle without batting an eye. His idiocy is incurable."
"And… he doesn't have a father, either… Not only that, but his mother neglects him too…"
"…Is that why you fell for him? Because his circumstances were similar, but he still tried his best? Did that make him appear charming to you?"
"Stop it…"
"Well, normally, no woman would be so impassioned talking about a guy that she doesn't even love or anything, you know?"
"Stop it…"
"Hmmm…"
"Uu… ugh…"
"While I wasn't looking, my Kazusa has grown into a woman who cries over lost love, huh…"
"…Is it really that strange?"
"No, I think it's actually cute for my daughter to be like that."
"Shut up…! I hate you after all…"
"Here's a handkerchief."
"I don't need it! I have my own…"
"Have you calmed down a bit?"
"I wasn't upset over anything to begin with."
"There are some complicated matters I want to talk to you about, if that's alright?"
"…What is it?"
"I'm planning to move from Paris to Vienna."
"Well, you have my blessing. Have you grown tired of French men?"
"…If you can joke about it like that, I guess you have calmed down."
"I wasn't joking, though. Anyway, I don't see how it's any of my business."
"Would you like to come with me?"
"There's a catch, of course. You'll need to be able to make a living off playing the piano alone if you want me to bring you along."
"What's this, all of a sudden? You already abandoned me three years ago."
"I think you can grow even more with the way you are now. …At least, that's the impression I got after seeing you perform at that school festival."
"That's got nothing to do with everything I've been doing up until now. I was just messing around…"
"Yes, you looked like you were having a lot of fun messing around with your music. That's exactly why."
"…I don't understand. I really don't understand what you're saying."
"The way you were mad conscious about how you were being looked at, and the way you tried to show off just how dazzling you were."
"What do you mean, 'mad'… No one uses that kind of expression in Japan anymore."
"I do think you should have tried to show off to the audience rather than to the boy next to you, though…"
"I didn't do that!"
"…It's been a long time since a performance of yours was so on point. I really liked it."
"You're just making fun of me here, aren't you?"
"A certain publishing company will be holding a competition early next year. An acquaintance of mine is the chief editor there, so I think I can still get you on the list of performers."
"Wait a minute…"
"You must participate in this competition and convince me, this time with your proper craft.
…That's my condition. What do you say?"
"I said wait!"
"If you don't want to listen to me after all that's happened, you can just stay in Japan. I'll continue covering all your living expenses, just as I have until now."
"Why do you… always have to ignore people and say whatever you feel like?"

"But if you have both the will and ability, Kazusa, I can raise you to become a pro overseas. It's okay if you don't resign yourself fully, and I don't mind if you'd be doing it to forget about that boy, either."
"I want you to decide."
